adjustment.analysis: Baseline median is 3.4. Father's Day (Sun) is a known driver, but noise-adjusted effect from one past occurrence (2024) is x1.0, and 2025 had a promo complicating the signal. This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-101% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
